name: Parallel Brick Renderer
definition: A renderer that subdivides a volume dataset into convex objects (bricks) that fit into GPU video memory, processes them in parallel using threads, and composites results via sort-last alpha blending.
summary: The Parallel Brick Renderer is a sort-last parallel volume rendering method that subdivides datasets into bricks for concurrent multi-thread rendering, differing from serial renderers by avoiding sequential leaf node processing.
